name: juru-speedtest
description: Juru Speedtest - Uji Kecepatan Internet, Latensi, Bufferbloat & Diagnostik Jaringan Akurat

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap copy android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && npx cap copy android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../Juru-Speedtest-v1.0.0-debug.apk
scripts.android:aab: npm run build && npx cap copy android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ../Juru-Speedtest-v1.0.0-release.aab
